scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist', 'public', 'build'].forEach(d => fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', d, {recursive: true}));"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
